dedupe_keys.name: meteo gr weather station network and climate data national observatory of athens

description: meteo.gr, the weather service of the National Observatory of Athens, publishes live observations from its network of automatic weather stations and climate data for Greece. The station network page lists stations by region across Thrace, Macedonia, Epirus, Thessaly, Central Greece, Euboea, the Peloponnese, the Ionian and Aegean islands and Crete, several hundred in all, each linked to its current readings, and the site adds lightning maps, cameras and forecast maps. The climate section offers cooling and heating degree days, climate anomalies by year and month, climate data, snow cover, a cloud atlas and data from the historic climate station of the National Observatory of Athens at Thiseio, the oldest in Greece and one of the oldest in the eastern Mediterranean, operating without interruption since 1890; that application was built under a national research network on climate change and its impacts. Access is free online under the site's terms of use; no open licence is stated on the pages read. Caveats: the station pages show current readings, and bulk historical data is not offered for download on the pages read. Coverage is Greece, with some neighbouring places. It supports hazard exposure and climate adaptation analysis of heat, heavy rain and snow for energy demand, roads and water systems; related records are the Cyprus Department of Meteorology climatology and the IMN Costa Rica climate atlas and stations.
